candidates.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 1 - basis of HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: HM Land Registry states Ordnance Survey mapping shows topographic features existing at survey time.
OS mapping is multi-purpose and its detail is not intended to represent property boundaries.
HM Land Registry plans use OS mapping as their mapping basis.
semantic_limits: OS topographic detail and mapping scale are not an exact legal boundary and are not elevation evidence.

candidates.name: Guidance for preparing plans for HM Land Registry applications
verified_facts: Application/deed plans must allow the land to be identified clearly on the Ordnance Survey map.
Plans should show precise extent for the registration transaction, stated scale, north point and sufficient surrounding detail.
semantic_limits: Registration-plan precision and identification requirements do not create LiDAR vertical accuracy or prove a determined boundary.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - LiDAR data metadata
verified_facts: EA states index catalogues can be downloaded for its products.
The catalogues include details on the time of year the data was collected.
semantic_limits: Catalogue metadata is required lineage evidence but is not itself an elevation raster or parcel-specific contributing-survey match.

candidates.name: LiDAR Composite spatial metadata index GeoPackage migration
verified_facts: LiDAR Composite download ZIPs include a spatial metadata index file in GeoPackage format.
EA says the index describes the spatial location and temporal extent of the raster elevation data.
EA notes technical guides describe the format and attribute schema of the index files.
semantic_limits: The GeoPackage index is metadata, not elevation pixels; temporal extent must not be substituted for the exact contributing survey without a match.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 10m
verified_facts: EA states the 10m DTM is resampled from the Composite DTM 2m dataset using bilinear interpolation.
The source composite itself merges time-stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
EA states the composite vertical accuracy as +/-15cm RMSE.
semantic_limits: The 10m product is explicitly derived/coarser and is excluded from primary parcel extrema and native-resolution validation.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: practice guides collection
verified_facts: The official collection routes to PG40 supplement 1 through supplement 6.
It shows current guide dates including PG40s2 13 October 2025, PG40s3/4 1 June 2026 and PG40s5 13 July 2026.
semantic_limits: Collection currentness selects the applicable guidance only; it is not parcel geometry, survey lineage or terrain data.
